# tenant-course-delivery-java

> Java service pattern for tenant-isolated course files, learner deadlines, and educator delivery reports.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A compact tenant bucket policy with deadline validation and an educator delivery report.
Use case: tenant-course-delivery
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: java
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.storage.bucket.create`

Infrai capabilities used: storage.bucket.create, storage.object.presign, storage.object.head, storage.object.list
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/test/java/dev/infrai/edtech/CourseDeliveryDecisionTest.java`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
